howto.what: Claude 的每次 Read、Edit、Bash 操作都会变成一条压缩后的观察记录,并在会话结束时汇总。相关的记录会自动注入之后的提问,让新会话带着上次的上下文开始,不用重新解释代码库。
howto.when: 当你问「claude-mem 是怎么工作的」或「它到底在做什么」时接管。同一项目从第二次会话起才会自动注入记忆,首次会话用于建立记忆。

say.note: 讲解它如何捕获、注入记忆及数据存放位置。

say.text: 运行 /learn-codebase 把整个仓库读进记忆

howto.what_en: Every Read, Edit, and Bash Claude makes becomes a compressed observation; observations are summarized at session end. Relevant ones are auto-injected into later prompts, so the next session starts with context from the last.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask "how does claude-mem work?" or "what is this thing doing?". Memory injection starts on your second session in a project; the first one seeds memory.

say_en.note: Explains capture, injection, and where data lives.

say_en.text: Where does claude-mem store its data?
say_en.note: It stays in ~/.claude-mem on this machine.

say_en.text: Run /learn-codebase to front-load the whole repo
